name: demo_story
description: Step 0 replays four REAL headlines from the committed CACHED_REAL sample (data/cache/sample), unchanged and badged CACHED_REAL with their capture time; they were chosen because none of them triggers a stress run, so the scripted results below are unaffected. Then the SYNTHETIC scripted demo (spec section 10). Headlines are invented for the demo and are labelled SYNTHETIC everywhere; they imitate the style of real sources only to pick a credibility prior. Sequence: (1) low-risk positive product launch at a small held US issuer, seen on social media -> low impact, no trigger; (2) credit downgrade + regulatory probe at a held issuer -> idiosyncratic stress; (3) market-wide geopolitical shock reported by a news wire and then corroborated by a second, independent source -> systemic stress. After step 2 the story holds for 20 s (hold_after_s) so the presenter can show the Early Warning Watchlist (Tata Motors: WATCH-NEGATIVE).
